args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

tests/test_money.py expects half-even behavior, but round_money was
still using ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build to fail.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 we must use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build failure since `tests/test_money.py` asserts half-even behavior (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Changes
- Switched the rounding mode in `src/money.py` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch: **passed** (including `tests/test_money.py`).

Merging requires code-owner approval (alex).
